title: Virtua Cop
overview:
We're the Virtua Cops! We'll protect the citizens from vicious terrorists!

The latest in the Virtua series, a 3D CG gun shooting game, arrives!

A detective who uncovered an illegal gun-running ring run by the crime syndicate E.V.L. Inc. has been murdered. As officers Michael Hardy and James Cools of a special task force, you go after Joe Fang and his gang.

Gunmen pop out across texture-mapped 3D stages while lock-on markers show who is about to fire. Shoot them down before they shoot you, but spare the civilians. Break crates to find machine guns and shotguns to supplement your pistol, and face a boss at the end of each stage.

- 1-2 players, cooperative
- Training mode for target practice and a two-player versus option
- Play with the Virtua Gun or a control pad
